title: Ad Click Aggregator
prompt: Design a system that records ad clicks, redirects users to the advertiser, and lets advertisers query click counts per ad per minute in near real time, accurate enough for billing.
functionalReqs: Record clicks and redirect to the advertiser URL
Aggregate clicks per ad per minute
Query counts over time ranges with filters
nonFunctionalReqs: Query results within ~1 minute of the click

scale.storage: ~1 B clicks/day raw; aggregates much smaller
